result.summary: This is a screenshot of the 'Your Updates' screen from the Spotify mobile app. It shows a list of recent activity notifications, including concert announcements, a friend accepting a Blend invite, and ticket sales. An 'Options' bottom sheet is overlaid at the bottom with a 'Mark all as read' button.
